summary.en: A little whale-eared maid who reacts to how many agent sessions are running or unread.
summary.zh-Hans: 鲸鱼鳍耳的小女仆，按运行中与未读的 agent 会话数做出不同动作。

summary.en: Read-only access to DeepSeek Harness's session folder, to count running and unread sessions. Without it the whale just dozes.
summary.zh-Hans: 只读访问 DeepSeek Harness 的会话目录，用来统计运行中与未读会话。未允许时鲸娘只播放待机打盹动画。
